Flow.description:
Validate Flow State checks for Assessor/User's Flow State on IMGA Risk Assessment or At Risk KPI, if Flow State is found returns all category data and Flow_State__c.RecordId. If Flow State cannot be found for the User/Assessor Flow Screen Settings are retrieved and User is prompted to Accept/Reject risk. If risk is rejected user is prompted to enter a reject reason and updates appropriate assessment record. If risk is accepted flow state is created, appropriate assessment is updated, and risk categories are determined.
Changed the dynamic choice for the at risk status list filter criteria.
Flow.label: Validate Flow State
